title: Make the Story Bible persistence contract explicit
description: Codify Story Bible as a local-only draft surface in UI, copy, docs, and tests: 5 authoring fields stay in localStorage, 2 list sections stay graph-backed reads, and no gateway- or Tauri-backed project persistence is added in this task. Create the focused `StoryBiblePanel` test surface if it does not already exist.

criteria: 1 persistence contract is rendered in the panel and states that 5 draft fields are local-only: `[braindump, genres, synopsis, outline, style]`.
1 documentation update explains that 2 list sections are graph-backed reads: `[characters, locations]`, and are not part of the local draft payload.
1 new or updated dedicated desktop component test covers local draft restore or fallback semantics and verifies the boundary copy is visible.
convergence.verification: npm --prefix desktop run test -- src/components/StoryBiblePanel.test.tsx && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck
convergence.definition_of_done: Users can tell from the panel and docs that Story Bible is currently a local draft aid with graph enrichment, not project-synced persistence, and the behavior is locked by a focused test.
